Author: koko
Name: Story Journal
Punchline: A journal of your journey through the main story, written as you play and read on kokos-tools.com.
Description:
The in-game half of Story Journal on kokos-tools.com. As you play, it writes down your journey through the main story: the quests you take and finish (with the game's own journal for them), cutscenes, the places you reach, the duties you clear, your levels and the people you meet; and, when you ask, the line on screen or a photo without the HUD. The site turns it into recaps, a Codex that grows with you, chapters and a storybook.

In the game it makes coming back easy: a Welcome back card with three lines of story and the next step (flagged on your map), a journal window that says why you're doing what you're doing, a small tracker, cards about new places and people you've met, an end of session card, and a card when a chapter closes. Seal theories and settle them later, and keep pace with a friend.

Nothing shows anything past your own last finished quest unless you turn spoilers off on the site. Link it with a token from kokos-tools.com (Settings → Story Journal). Open it with /sj.
